column1: # Redaction corpus (task qp4): real secret carriers, one case per line,
# read by internal/redact's TestCorpus (every kind) and by the Java
# agent's CorpusTest (the header and url kinds, which its Redaction
# copies). Fields are separated by one TAB:
# kind    argv (the inputs are the argv elements, through Policy.Argv),
#         header (name and value, through Policy.Header and
#         Redaction.header) or url (one URL or request target, through
# expect  masked: the canary SEKRET must not survive.
#         limit:<tag>: an accepted limit; the canary must survive, and
#         <tag> must be a row of the "Accepted limits" table in
#         limit that starts to be masked fails the test, so the line
#         becomes a masked one and the doc is updated with it.
# note    where the form comes from: a tool, a language, an earlier
#         leak task (zi4, 0j4, rm4, np4, op4, qp4, wp4).
# Every input holds the canary SEKRET. "<TAB>" in an input stands for a
# TAB character and "<U+XXXX>" (four upper-case hex digits) for that
# code point, so white space and other invisible runes stay readable
# here (task xp4). Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are skipped.
